Question 4
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=sin⁡(2t), where t is the time. If the particle is at the position x=3 when t=0, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=5−2cos⁡(2t)
b
x(t)=52+12cos⁡(2t)
c
x(t)=72+12sin⁡(2t)
d
x(t)=12cos⁡(2t)
e
x(t)=72−12cos⁡(2t)
Submit
